title: Shaker: Demand in Mecca Driven by Faith not Cycles
summary: Indonesia's sovereign investment body Danantara has completed a $533 million property acquisition in Mecca. Thakher Development announced the handing over of the title, marking the first time land at Thakher Makkah has been made available to investors from outside Saudi Arabia. Faisal Shaker, CEO of Thakher Development spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa on property ownership in one of the Holy Cities in Saudi Arabia. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Tech Stocks Decline on AI Jitters, Dollar Falls: Markets Wrap

title: Japan’s 20-Year Bond Auction Sees Strongest Demand on Record
summary: Japan’s 20-year government bond auction Tuesday saw the strongest demand on record, a signal that elevated yields are starting to lure domestic investors back into the market.

summary: "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" brings you everything you need to know to get ahead as the trading day begins in Asia. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Oct. 20
summary: Brent oil fluctuated near a five-month high as traders weighed the risk of further Iranian attacks in the Strait of Hormuz against robust crude flows from the Persian Gulf.

title: SoftBank Credit Risk Hits 4-Year High on AI Funding Strain
summary: SoftBank Group Corp.’s credit risk, as measured by its credit-default swaps, has risen to the highest level in nearly four years as concerns grow over AI-related funding and a potential large acquisition.

title: Stephen Roach: Xi May Be Using Trump Summits to Buy Time
summary: Stephen Roach argues Xi Jinping’s willingness to engage in a series of meetings with Donald Trump may reflect concern about China’s economy and a desire to buy time. Roach suggests Xi may not share the personal camaraderie Trump portrays and says Chinese officials are likely realistic about how much progress is possible with an unpredictable counterpart. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Corn Faces Longest Losing Streak Since Early 2025 on Weak Demand
summary: US corn futures fell for a sixth day, their longest losing streak since March 2025, as harvest pressure and weak exports led hedge funds to sell their positions at a rapid pace.

title: IMF's Mills on China Policy Stimulus
summary: Marshall Mills, the IMF's Senior Resident Representative for China, says the country needs more "urgent and forceful" measures to boost the property and consumption sectors. He speaks with Stephen Engle on the sidelines of the Bund Summit in Shanghai. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: MTR CEO on Hong Kong's Northern Metropolis
summary: Jeny Yeung, CEO at MTR, discusses the opportunities she sees for the railway operator as it expands into Hong Kong's Northern Metropolis. She speaks exclusively on "Bloomberg: The China Show." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: More China Stimulus Needed Despite Easing: Polka Mishra
summary: The People's Bank of China could effectively cut rates by shifting its policy benchmark from the seven-day reverse-repo rate to the overnight rate. Javelin Wealth Management Partner Polka Mishra describes the initiative as an "effective easing", but warns it is likely not sufficient to revive consumer sentiment and more akin to "drip feeding". (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Copper Holds Drop as Traders Gauge Risks From US Tariff Policy

title: Indonesia Stocks Rebound as Authorities Step Up Response to MSCI
summary: Indonesian stocks rebounded from their worst rout in nearly four decades after authorities unveiled fresh measures aimed at averting a potential two-step downgrade by MSCI Inc.

title: PBOC Rate Shift Plan Would Lower Borrowing Costs: Analysts
summary: The People’s Bank of China’s consideration of shifting its policy rate benchmark to the overnight reverse-repo rate would effectively lower borrowing costs, supporting bond investments, according to analysts.

title: Chipmakers Lead Korean Stock Selloff on Yield Spike, IPO Stumble
